title: Trend of SingPost's Compliance with Postal Quality of Service Standards and Feedback Received on Service Improvements
what_it_is: Trend of SingPost's Compliance with Postal Quality of Service Standards and Feedback Received on Service Improvements

sections.label: Postal service quality feedback data
sections.summary: IMDA publishes compliance data; in 2025 it received 23 feedback items on misdelivered and delayed letters, similar to 2023 and 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Data on this compliance is published on the Infocomm Media Development Authority's (IMDA's) website.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: In 2025, last year, IMDA received 23 pieces of feedback on postal service quality, all of which were related to misdelivered letters and delays in letter delivery.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Similar trends were observed in 2023 and 2024.

sections.label: Singapore postal QoS standards comparison
sections.summary: A case will be looked into, and Singapore's QoS standards are among the most stringent compared to other countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I know Edusave Awards mean a lot to parents and their children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: And hearing this, I will ask my IMDA colleagues to take a look into this particular case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: In terms of the comparison of our QoS standards with other countries, in fact, Singapore has one of the most stringent QoS requirements compared to many other countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For example, in Hong Kong, for Hongkong Post, letters are typically delivered within one to three days.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: And for many other countries the letters are generally delivered between two and five days.
